verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Name.com issues API tokens via Account Settings and uses HTTP Basic Authentication, but nothing documents limiting a token's permissions or scopes. Splitting tokens into development and production is environment separation, not least-privilege scoping. Reseller customer accounts with their own credentials and permissions are an adjacent feature, not scoped agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
